label: End-independent reasons for moral obligations remain an open bridge
paraphrase: OPEN bridge: whether every moral obligation supplies each relevant rational agent with a normative reason independently of contingent ends. A theory that denies this bridge owes its replacement account, but Railton's denial of universal instrumental reasons and Boyd's allowance for motivational indifference do not themselves entail that either theory denies all such normative reasons. This is not built into moral realism, and the naturalist consistency witnesses do not settle it.
